confidence_note: Checked against book text (Love Everything That Happens: Amor Fati). Old text dropped: "Marcus: nothing you can wish away" quote and the energy-resistance framing, not in the book. Edison appears only as a one-clause link; his fire is story 1264.
facts: The chapter opens with Nietzsche: greatness is wanting nothing to be different and loving, not merely bearing, what is necessary.
Jack Johnson in his famous fifteen-round fight with Jim Jeffries, the Great White Hope, called out of retirement to beat the ascendant black champion; Johnson genuinely hated by opponent and crowd.
Johnson smiled, joked, played the whole fight; Holiday: no value in any other reaction, bitterness was their burden.
He built the fight plan around the abuse: each nasty remark from Jeffries's corner got another lacing; low tricks answered with a quip, never losing his cool.
A blow opened a cut on his lip and he kept smiling; each round happier while Jeffries grew enraged and tired and lost the will; fight ended with Jeffries on the floor.
Jack London from ringside: the story of the fight is the story of a smile.
Holiday: acceptance is a first step; better is love; not "I'm okay with this" but "I feel great about it."
Caveat: good does not always outweigh bad nor is it free; some good always sits within the bad.
tension: Johnson was hated by everyone in the room and still enjoyed the fight.
opening_idea: Open on the split lip and the smile.

lessons.idea: Turn a difficult behavior into material for your plan.
lessons.anchor: Johnson built his fight plan around the abuse.
lessons.everyday_example_idea: A consultant whose client interrupts puts the main point first and prepares a line to resume.

reflect_final: If you know a situation this week will probably irritate you, what small change could you make to your plan to include it?

use_cases.situation: Someone cuts you off in every meeting.
use_cases.move: Say you allowed for interruptions and will make the point in three sentences.

use_cases.situation: The same remark at every family dinner.
use_cases.move: Acknowledge it lightly and move on.

use_cases.situation: A dull job you cannot avoid.

pocket_idea: Build an unavoidable difficult situation into your plan.
